div.div: From vague idea to tested, versioned resource — agent guides at every step

switch.text: From vague idea to tested, versioned resource — agent guides at every step

div.div:
2. Agent asks questions
What problem? Input/output?
Who invokes? External tools?
Scope? How to test?

3. Agent classifies
Type: skill/rule/wf/agent
Complexity: simple/complex
Name: follows conventions

4. Agent creates design
design.md — purpose, contracts,
steps, edge cases, test strategy

5. Agent creates diagrams
flow.drawio + sequence.drawio
Export to PNG at 3x scale

6. Agent scaffolds
Create resource files
Frontmatter + step headers
(no implementation yet)

7. Agent implements
Fill in each step
Present step-by-step
to engineer for review

8. Agent proposes test plan
Which specimens? Need new ones?
What to validate?

10. Release
version bump + CHANGELOG
git tag
